the host uses the current connection and returns authenticated JSON without exposing credentials

acceptanceScenarios.request: POST /v1/images/generations, POST /v1/videos, or a profile-declared POST /v1/videos/edits
acceptanceScenarios.expect: the host sends the relative path and profile-declared JSON or multipart body once without changing model or parameters

acceptanceScenarios.request: GET a submitted task's status and content paths
acceptanceScenarios.expect: the host continues only the supplied task_id and never submits a replacement task

acceptanceScenarios.request: GET a completed task's content path
acceptanceScenarios.expect: the host returns or attaches native media bytes; URLs, HTML, SVG, task IDs, and status text are not a completed delivery

userMediaInput.fallback: When the current host cannot deliver the user's attachment as a profile-declared transport, stop before submission, explain the declared transport, and do not invent a URL, file ID, or upload path. When it can deliver multipart_file bytes, send them only with the one Images/Videos API request; the Pure Tokens gateway owns short-lived R2 staging and never returns the provider-facing URL. A public HTTPS URL, file ID, or voice ID explicitly supplied by the user may be sent only in the exact live-profile field whose declared transport permits it; the Skill never downloads, validates, or rehosts it.

mediaDeliveryResourceBounds.fallback: If the host cannot hand off a native media response without creating unbounded background work, cached copies, or duplicated reads, stop before content delivery and report that same-task native delivery is unavailable. Do not substitute a URL, HTML, SVG, status text, or a re-submitted task.

balance.fallback: If the current host does not expose this authenticated account read, tell the user to use that connection's client balance view; do not estimate or ask for credentials.
